n.description: chunk number to read — the n in a `path#n` reference (page number for PDFs). Omit when `path` already carries the `#n` anchor.

page_image.description: PDF only: return a raster of page `n` as JPEG (200 DPI) instead of text/embeds. Use when tables or layout are hard to read as text. Requires the server to be started with --vision.

path.description: the copy-ready `path#n` token exactly as a search/grep/read result showed it (or just the document path, paired with `n` below)
